packet_structure.header: 0x004c (Apple Company ID, 2 bytes) + 0x05 (Type, 1 byte) + Length (1 byte)

fields.description: Protocol version (bits 7-4), Discovery mode (Everyone vs ContactsOnly, bits 1-0)
SHA-256 truncated hash of iCloud Apple Account Apple ID handle
SHA-256 truncated hash of verified telephone number in E.164 format
SHA-256 truncated hash of primary Apple ID email address
Pre-computed contact hashes for mutual cryptographic contact validation
Rotating token for NameDrop / proximity bump exchange
AWDL readiness, current channel flags (2.4 GHz ch 6 / 5 GHz ch 44/149)

0x05_airdrop.security_considerations: Hashes are salted with a rolling ephemeral salt updated every 15 minutes to prevent persistent tracking. Contacts-Only mode requires mutual cryptographic identity validation via IDS before initiating AWDL link.

fields.description: Accessory in pairing mode (bit 0), Case open (bit 1), Lid open (bit 2)
Hardware device model (AirPods 1/2/3/4, AirPods Pro 1/2, AirPods Max, Apple Pencil, Beats)
Left earbud battery level (0-100%, 7 bits) + charging indicator (1 bit)
Right earbud battery level (0-100%, 7 bits) + charging indicator (1 bit)
Charging case battery level (0-100%, 7 bits) + charging indicator (1 bit)
Sequence counter for battery telemetry updates
Hardware chassis color variant for rendering accurate 3D pairing modal UI
Encrypted authentication tag derived from iCloud account shared link key

0x07_proximity_pairing.security_considerations: Accessory battery telemetry is AES-GCM encrypted using link keys shared across iCloud Keychain, preventing eavesdropping on battery and presence by un-paired devices.

fields.description: Acoustic signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) confidence score calculated by AOP2 / CoreSpeech
Hardware device preference hierarchy (HomePod > iPhone > Apple Watch > Mac > iPad)
Face-up detection, in-use flag, active playback state
Truncated hash of user utterance acoustic profile for duplicate suppression
Monotonically increasing arbitration session counter

0x09_heysiri.security_considerations: Arbitration packets are unencrypted to minimize latency (< 80 ms), enabling real-time single-device response before the acoustic synthesizer activates.

fields.description: Handoff type: Web Browsing (0x01), App Activity (0x02), Universal Clipboard (0x08)
Monotonically increasing sequence number to reject replayed activities
Cryptographic hash of the current NSUserActivity or UIPasteboard payload
AES-CMAC authentication tag computed with the device's Handoff AES-128 key

0x0c_handoff.security_considerations: Raw activity contents and URLs are NEVER broadcast over BLE. Only authenticated hashes are broadcast; receiving peers fetch full payloads over IDS Alloy or direct TLS connections.

fields.description: Hotspot enabled (bit 0), Battery powered (bit 1), Data roaming (bit 2)
Cellular reception signal level (0 to 5 bars)
Radio Access Technology: 5G Standalone (0x05), 5G Non-Standalone (0x04), LTE (0x03)
Host iPhone battery percentage (0-100%)
Rolling cryptographic token matching peers under the same iCloud account

0x0d_tethering.security_considerations: Enables remote Wi-Fi SoftAP wake-up without requiring user interaction on the host device, gated by mutual iCloud identity validation.

fields.description: Nearby action: Apple TV Keyboard (0x01), Wi-Fi Password Share (0x02), HomePod Setup (0x05)
Proximity trigger threshold, prompt suppression flag, target device class
Truncated hash of target device identifier
Cryptographic authentication tag derived from proximity key

0x10_nearbyaction.security_considerations: Requires RSSI proximity verification (typically RSSI > -50 dBm) and UI confirmation before triggering automated credentials or keyboard inputs.

0x12_findmy.protocol_name: Find My Offline Finding & Crowd-Sourced Location Beacon

fields.description: Battery status (bits 7-6), Separation state (bit 5), Firmware version (bits 4-0)
First 28 bytes of NIST P-256 ephemeral public key (derived via SHA-256 ratchet)

0x12_findmy.security_considerations: Ephemeral public keys rotate every 15 minutes based on an ANSI X9.63 KDF ratchet. Only the device owner possessing the master private key can decrypt crowd-sourced location reports forwarded to Apple's Find My servers.

operating_channels.purpose: Social channel for legacy beaconing & initial sync discovery
Primary low-interference indoor social & unicast transfer channel
Primary outdoor social & high-throughput unicast transfer channel

master_rank_attributes: Battery charge state (high capacity > low capacity)

transitions.condition: Missing 3 consecutive Sync Frames from Master
Broadcasts own Election Metric for 2 superframes without defeat
Receives Sync Frame with higher Election Metric

availability_window_scheduling.extension_windows: Allocated dynamically for bulk payload transfers (e.g., AirDrop files, Sidecar frames)
availability_window_scheduling.coexistence: Synchronously alternates between infrastructure BSSID channels and AWDL availability windows using hardware Time-Division Multiplexing (TDM)

connection_handshake_sequence.action: Discovery & mutual presence beaconing over BLE (2.4 GHz)
Nodes tune to common Social Channel (ch 44) during Availability Window 0
SLAAC address generation (fe80::/64) derived from AWDL MAC address
Mutual TLS handshake with Apple ID certificates & SRP key validation
High-throughput payload streaming via Extension Windows

transport_arbitration.characteristics: Low power, high latency, available when devices are within 10 meters
High bandwidth, medium power, dynamically negotiated for large assets & updates
Used when Bluetooth is severed but both devices share a known Wi-Fi network
Fall-back for remote synchronization across cellular / internet

data_models.device_registry: NRDevice / NRRegistry containing pairing state, paired Watch UUID, hardware capabilities, watchOS build, and pairing cryptographic credentials
data_models.delta_sync_protocol: Atomic registry transaction logs recorded in Class A / Class C storage with rolling generation counters
data_models.property_bags: Synchronized property bags for settings, notifications, cellular provisioning, and health sync authorization

coordinating_daemons.role: Handoff activity streamer & clipboard payload coordinator
System pasteboard server, local UIPasteboard serialization/deserialization

transfer_thresholds.small_payload_transport: Inline compressed payload embedded directly in Handoff IDS Alloy notification
transfer_thresholds.large_payload_transport: Metadata advertised via BLE (0x0C); full payload fetched on-demand via direct AWDL TLS socket when user issues Paste command

universal_clipboard_sync.security_policy: Payloads are purged from memory immediately upon device lock or after 120 seconds of inactivity. Content is protected with AKS Class A / Class C encryption.

aks_class_a_sync.system_subsystem: Apple KeyStore (AKS) Complete Protection Class A

keybag_mechanics.hardware_backing: Hardware Secure Enclave Processor (SEP) UID & Key Derivation Function
keybag_mechanics.lifecycle: Keybag encryption keys are held in volatile DRAM only while the device is in the Unlocked state. Upon device lock (kAKSKeyBagLockStateLocked), the Class A key is zeroized from DRAM.
keybag_mechanics.companion_sync_implication: NanoRegistry Class A properties (pathToNanoRegistryClassAFile, NRRemoteObjectClassA) and IDS Class A messages CANNOT be decrypted or transmitted while host device is locked.

pcs_class_a_sync.system_subsystem: Protected Cloud Storage (PCS) Class A Key Synchronization

cryptographic_mechanics.purpose: Synchronizes CloudKit and iCloud Keychain identity keys between paired Apple Watch and host iPhone across the IDS Magnet channel.
cryptographic_mechanics.wrapping_format: ECDH NIST P-256 key agreement with AES-GCM-256 key wrapping (RFC 3394 / RFC 5649).
cryptographic_mechanics.trust_root: User iCloud Security Code (iCSC) and Hardware Secure Enclave escrow identity.

key_architecture.key_type: Long-Term Key (LTK) - NIST P-256 ECDH Keypair
key_architecture.storage: Secure Enclave Hardware Storage & Class A Keychain (com.apple.sharing.pairing)
key_architecture.derivation: Shared secret derived via SEP ECDH, expanded using HKDF-SHA256 with device IDs and session nonces into directional AES-GCM-256 session keys
key_architecture.attestation: LocalAttestedLTK verified against peer device public key during initial Bluetooth pairing

ranging_and_proximity_verification.anti_relay_defense: Enforces strict Round-Trip Time (RTT) Time-of-Flight ranging via AWDL / Ultra-Wideband (UWB)
ranging_and_proximity_verification.failure_action: Authentication rejected if RTT indicates distance > 3m or packet timing anomaly detected

magic_pair_encryption.system_subsystem: Magic Pair & Accessory Cloud Identity Envelope

pairing_mechanics.envelope_construction: Accessory firmware and host iOS device establish an authenticated link key using P-256 ECDH over BLE L2CAP.
pairing_mechanics.cloud_propagation: Link key is wrapped using CloudKit PCS and escrowed into iCloud Keychain under access group com.apple.sharing.pairing.
pairing_mechanics.cross_device_switching: All iPads, Macs, Apple Watches, and Apple TVs under the same iCloud account synchronize the link key, enabling zero-click audio routing.

advertising_token_format.cipher: AES-128 in ECB/CTR mode with 15-minute rotating IV
advertising_token_format.verification: Host devices decrypt the 0x07 BLE advertisement payload using the synchronized account link key. If authentication tag matches, battery UI appears.
